selected_evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled to run inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 with output retained in the log
selected_evidence.summary: Installed /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance with '15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1', made script executable, created the log file, reloaded crond, and confirmed a manual run appends output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log.
Captured boot_id bf4e9cbb-84f9-45f0-9b81-6602b98cea07, crond active, cron.d entry present, and existing log content before restart.
Issued 'sudo -n systemctl reboot' backgrounded so the acknowledgement returned before the node disconnected.

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof node1 actually restarted (changed boot identity)
selected_evidence.summary: Node was unreachable immediately after reboot (connection timed out), then became reachable again with a new boot_id 8d85238c-fe51-472f-83ee-8dce9ef4a78e, differing from the pre-restart value.

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of required services, data, and cron functionality on node1
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, confirmed crond active, cron.d entry intact, script still executable, log file persisted with prior entries, and a fresh manual run successfully appended a new line to the log.

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== script contents =="
cat /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance

echo "== make executable =="
sudo -n chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
ls -l /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance

echo "== install cron.d entry =="
sudo -n tee /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance >/dev/null <<'EOF'
SHELL=/bin/sh
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1
EOF
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance

echo "== ensure log file exists =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
sudo -n chmod 644 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
ls -l /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log

echo "== reload cron =="
sudo -n systemctl reload crond 2>/dev/null || sudo -n systemctl restart crond
systemctl is-active crond

echo "== manual run test =="
sudo -n /bin/sh -c '/usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
echo "exit=$?"
echo "== log tail =="
tail -20 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
